candidate.answerReason: In the usual vertical-wall and level-floor model, the wall contains a line perpendicular to the floor, so their planes are perpendicular.

methods.label: Use a perpendicular line in the wall
methods.explanation: The wall and the floor intersect along the foot of the wall, and the wall contains a line perpendicular to the floor.
methods.levelReason: This applies the elementary perpendicular-planes criterion to the usual geometric model.
